text: SpinSmart Plasmid Purification Protocol: High-copy plasmid DNA from E. coli

payload.title: SpinSmart Plasmid Purification Protocol: High-copy plasmid DNA from E. coli

text: Start with 1-5 ml E. coli LB culture*, pellet cells in a microcentrifuge for 30 sec at 11,000 x g. Discard the supernatant and remove as much of the liquid as possible.

payload.text: Start with 1-5 ml E. coli LB culture*, pellet cells in a microcentrifuge for 30 sec at 11,000 x g. Discard the supernatant and remove as much of the liquid as possible.

text: Add 250 µl PB1 Resuspension Buffer.

payload.text: Add 250 µl PB1 Resuspension Buffer.

text: Vortex or pipet up and down to resuspend the cell pellet completely.

payload.text: Vortex or pipet up and down to resuspend the cell pellet completely.

text: No cell clumps should be visible.

payload.text: No cell clumps should be visible.

text: Add 250 µl PB2 Lysis Buffer.

payload.text: Add 250 µl PB2 Lysis Buffer.

text: Invert the tube 6-8 times to mix completely.

payload.text: Invert the tube 6-8 times to mix completely.

text: Do not vortex!.

payload.text: Do not vortex!.

text: Incubate at room temperature for up to 5 min or until lysate appears clear.

payload.text: Incubate at room temperature for up to 5 min or until lysate appears clear.

text: Add 300 µl PB3 Neutralization Buffer.

payload.text: Add 300 µl PB3 Neutralization Buffer.

text: Invert the tube 6-8 times to mix completely.

payload.text: Invert the tube 6-8 times to mix completely.

text: Do not vortex!.

payload.text: Do not vortex!.

text: Centrifuge for 5 min at 11,000 x g at room temperature.

payload.text: Centrifuge for 5 min at 11,000 x g at room temperature.

text: If precipitate is not completely clear from the lysate, centrifuge again for 5 min at 11,000 x g at room temperature.

payload.text: If precipitate is not completely clear from the lysate, centrifuge again for 5 min at 11,000 x g at room temperature.

text: Place a SpinSmart Plasmid Binding Column in a Collection Tube (2 ml) and load a maximum of 750 µl of the supernatant (from the "Lysate Clarification" section above) onto the column.

payload.text: Place a SpinSmart Plasmid Binding Column in a Collection Tube (2 ml) and load a maximum of 750 µl of the supernatant (from the "Lysate Clarification" section above) onto the column.

text: Centrifuge for 1 min at 11,000 x g. Discard flow-through and place the SpinSmart Plasmid Binding Column into the Collection Tube (2 ml).

payload.text: Centrifuge for 1 min at 11,000 x g. Discard flow-through and place the SpinSmart Plasmid Binding Column into the Collection Tube (2 ml).

text: HB101 or strains of the JM series), perform a wash step with 500 µl PB4 Wash Buffer pre-warmed to 50°C.

payload.text: HB101 or strains of the JM series), perform a wash step with 500 µl PB4 Wash Buffer pre-warmed to 50°C.

text: Centrifuge for 1 min at 11,000 x g before proceeding with Buffer PB5.

payload.text: Centrifuge for 1 min at 11,000 x g before proceeding with Buffer PB5.

text: Add 600 µl PB5 Wash Buffer (make sure EtOH has been added).

payload.text: Add 600 µl PB5 Wash Buffer (make sure EtOH has been added).

text: Centrifuge for 1 min at 11,000 x g. Discard flow-through and place the SpinSmart Plasmid Column back into the empty Collection Tube (2 ml).

payload.text: Centrifuge for 1 min at 11,000 x g. Discard flow-through and place the SpinSmart Plasmid Column back into the empty Collection Tube (2 ml).

text: Centrifuge for 2 min at 11,000 x g and discard the Collection Tube (2 ml).

payload.text: Centrifuge for 2 min at 11,000 x g and discard the Collection Tube (2 ml).

text: Place the SpinSmart Plasmid Binding Column in a 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube (not provided) and add 50 µl PB6 Elution Buffer.

payload.text: Place the SpinSmart Plasmid Binding Column in a 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube (not provided) and add 50 µl PB6 Elution Buffer.

text: Incubate for 1 min at room temperature.

payload.text: Incubate for 1 min at room temperature.

text: Centrifuge for 1 min at 11,000 x g.

payload.text: Centrifuge for 1 min at 11,000 x g.

text: Super simple In vivo Hoechst staining of unicellular protists

payload.title: Super simple In vivo Hoechst staining of unicellular protists

text: Add 1/1000 Hoechst dye (1 uL into 1 mL volume of cells).Keep cells with dye protected from light.

payload.text: Add 1/1000 Hoechst dye (1 uL into 1 mL volume of cells).Keep cells with dye protected from light.

text: Incubate at room temperature for 10 minutes.Keep cells with dye protected from light.

payload.text: Incubate at room temperature for 10 minutes.Keep cells with dye protected from light.

text: Centrifuge cells at 1000g for 5 minutes.

payload.text: Centrifuge cells at 1000g for 5 minutes.

text: Resuspend with fresh growing medium.

payload.text: Resuspend with fresh growing medium.

text: Use minimum volume of medium in order to plate in to the slide immediately.

payload.text: Use minimum volume of medium in order to plate in to the slide immediately.

text: Mount your slide and ready for observation under microscope.

text: Full Contact Microbiology (a.k.a Diatom Transformation via Bacterial Conjugation)

payload.title: Full Contact Microbiology (a.k.a Diatom Transformation via Bacterial Conjugation)

text: Grow the diatom culture to mid-log phase (≈ 8.0E6 cells/ml for Phaeodactylum tricornutum grown on F/2 media or 5.0 E7 cell/ml when grown on BG-11).

payload.text: Grow the diatom culture to mid-log phase (≈ 8.0E6 cells/ml for Phaeodactylum tricornutum grown on F/2 media or 5.0 E7 cell/ml when grown on BG-11).

text: We have investigated transformation efficiency throughout the growth curve and found this to be the sweetspot.

payload.text: We have investigated transformation efficiency throughout the growth curve and found this to be the sweetspot.

text: Grow 1 mL of E. coli culture containing both the mobillity plasmid (Pta-MOB) and carrier plasmid, overnight (16-20 hrs) in LB+antibiotics, for each planned transformation.

payload.text: Grow 1 mL of E. coli culture containing both the mobillity plasmid (Pta-MOB) and carrier plasmid, overnight (16-20 hrs) in LB+antibiotics, for each planned transformation.

text: (We grow them at 37°C at 270 rpm in a shaking incubator.).

payload.text: (We grow them at 37°C at 270 rpm in a shaking incubator.).

text: On the day of transformation, use the overnight culture to inoculate 50 mL of fresh LB+antibiotic, 1:50 dilution, for each planned transformation.Grow to an OD600 of 0.8 - 1.0 (37°C with 270 rpm shaking).This takes about 3-4 hours.

payload.text: On the day of transformation, use the overnight culture to inoculate 50 mL of fresh LB+antibiotic, 1:50 dilution, for each planned transformation.Grow to an OD600 of 0.8 - 1.0 (37°C with 270 rpm shaking).This takes about 3-4 hours.

text: During the 3-4 hours the E. coli culture is growing, measure the Phaeodactylum tricornutum cell concentration with a FlowCam or haemocytometer to calculate the required volume needed to collect 2.5E8 cells for each transformation.

payload.text: During the 3-4 hours the E. coli culture is growing, measure the Phaeodactylum tricornutum cell concentration with a FlowCam or haemocytometer to calculate the required volume needed to collect 2.5E8 cells for each transformation.

text: For each transformation, centrifuge 50 mL of E. coli culture and the required Phaeodactylum tricornutum volume at 4000 x g for 10 minutes at 4°C.

payload.text: For each transformation, centrifuge 50 mL of E. coli culture and the required Phaeodactylum tricornutum volume at 4000 x g for 10 minutes at 4°C.

text: Resuspend E. coli pellet in 500 μL of SOC medium.Resuspend P. tricornutum pellet in 500 μL of L1 medium.

payload.text: Resuspend E. coli pellet in 500 μL of SOC medium.Resuspend P. tricornutum pellet in 500 μL of L1 medium.

text: Note: The diatom and E. coli cultures should be centrifuged at around the same time to minimize the amount of time they spend concentrated.

payload.text: Note: The diatom and E. coli cultures should be centrifuged at around the same time to minimize the amount of time they spend concentrated.

text: In a 1.5 mL tube mix 200 μl of E. coli cells with 200 μl of Phaeodactylum tricornutum cells.

payload.text: In a 1.5 mL tube mix 200 μl of E. coli cells with 200 μl of Phaeodactylum tricornutum cells.

text: Negative control:   In a 1.5 mL tube mix 200 μl of SOC medium with 200 μl of Phaeodactylum tricornutum cells.

payload.text: Negative control:   In a 1.5 mL tube mix 200 μl of SOC medium with 200 μl of Phaeodactylum tricornutum cells.

text: Note: Incubate and treat the negative control plates identically to conjugation plates.

payload.text: Note: Incubate and treat the negative control plates identically to conjugation plates.

text: Spread the mixture (400 μL) on Conjugation Plates.

payload.text: Spread the mixture (400 μL) on Conjugation Plates.

text: (0.5x BG-11 with 5% LB and 1% agar).

payload.text: (0.5x BG-11 with 5% LB and 1% agar).

text: Incubate plates for 90 minutes at 30°C in the dark.

payload.text: Incubate plates for 90 minutes at 30°C in the dark.

text: Move plates to light incubator (18°C and 100 μmol photons m-2 s-1) for 2 days.

payload.text: Move plates to light incubator (18°C and 100 μmol photons m-2 s-1) for 2 days.

text: Collect cells by adding 1 mL of L1 medium.

payload.text: Collect cells by adding 1 mL of L1 medium.

text: Use a cell scraper to concentrate cells and medium to one side of the plate.

payload.text: Use a cell scraper to concentrate cells and medium to one side of the plate.

text: Transfer resuspended cells to a 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube with a P1000 pipette and filter tips.

payload.text: Transfer resuspended cells to a 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube with a P1000 pipette and filter tips.

text: Spread 200 μl of the cell suspension on a Selection Plate.

payload.text: Spread 200 μl of the cell suspension on a Selection Plate.

text: Incubate at 18°C and 100 μmol photons m-2 s-1 until colonies appear.

payload.text: Incubate at 18°C and 100 μmol photons m-2 s-1 until colonies appear.

text: After a minimum of 8-12 days, untransformed Phaeodactylum tricornutum cells die off, and colonies of transformed cells begin to appear – in some cases, this can take 3-4 weeks.

payload.text: After a minimum of 8-12 days, untransformed Phaeodactylum tricornutum cells die off, and colonies of transformed cells begin to appear – in some cases, this can take 3-4 weeks.

text: Alternatively selection can be done in liquid BG-11 Selection media using eGFP as a reporter and sorted using FACS.
